data.name: Manoa Falls Electric Bike to Hike
data.headline: Power up with electric stallions to Hawaii's majestic Manoa Falls 12 mile ebike round trip-1.8 mile hike round trip.
data.description:
Enjoy a guided bike tour with a combination of 10-mile ebike including a 2 mile total hike to Hawaii's amazing waterfall, Manoa Falls. Followed by a healthy meal at a local cafe.

1:00 pm meeting time 10 minutes prior to tour start time, for bike fitting and safety helmet selection. Wear fitness wears or light clothing for cycling and exercise.

Your professional guide is advanced first aid - AED /CPR certification for your safety. We'll lead you on a healthy habits adventure in paradise. Your guide will share the amazing pathways.  Explore the features that make Hawaii one of the most desirable places to vacation or live.  Friendly informative narration while gliding through Hawaii's history, present, and future with photo stops throughout the tour. Engage along with multiple stops infused with hiking to Manoa Fallas back in Manoa Valley,  Follow your 2-mile total hike with a delicious meal at a local cafe.
data.highlights:
Wear shoes that can get muddy. Manoa Falls has been used in many movies, including Jurassic Park, Moana-(live action), and Aquaman: Lost Kingdom.
Depending on the Weather, we may ask to start early if possible to avoid heavy rains. We roll along with a local guide who shares the magic of Hawaii's history, present, and future with guests. The trail has some rain damage and steep and rolling terrain. Rainforest foliage and flowers with bamboo and albizia trees (Falcataria moluccana). Waterfall approximately 150" tall.  see images
data.itinerary: We meet up at the Center of Waikiki, @ Kuhio Beach Banyan Tree • 2453 Kalakaua Ave, Honolulu, HI 96815.   We provide adjustable helmets, cold water-x2,  Inclusive lunch on our way back to Waikiki. Electric bikes are both pedal-assist and throttle-controlled. We ride on bike paths, side streets, and through unique neighborhoods. Total e-bike distance approx.12 miles.  Total hiking distance: 1.8 miles with about 350' feet of elevation gain to the waterfall on a semi-groomed rainforest path. E-bikes are equipped with a one-way speaker system for informative narration and safety. Disposable rain gear- suncreeen/bug spray is provided by the guide. Inclusive photos and video clips are provided to guests after the tour.
